description: This file defines an abstract class SimplePage which implements the Page interface. The class manages page title and content, providing methods to initialize and retrieve the page content, with a simple generation logic.

classes.name: SimplePage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a basic page structure with title and content, providing methods to initialize and retrieve page content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the page with a title and content.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the raw content of the page without any processing.

methods.name: initializePage
methods.description: Initializes the page's title and content.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates and returns the page's content, currently returning the raw content.
